body:
Done. Created 9 prompt override files:

- `.thread/prompts/explorer.md`
- `.thread/prompts/builder.md`
- `.thread/prompts/reviewer.md`
- `.thread/prompts/tester.md`
- `.thread/prompts/bug-hunter.md`
- `.thread/prompts/scout.md`
- `.thread/prompts/designer.md`
- `.thread/prompts/worker.md`
- `.thread/prompts/worker-2.md`

Each uses `--- name/description ---` frontmatter and contains the forwarding rule: if plain-text user input (not a thread_send from coordinator), forward verbatim via `thread_send(to="coordinator", expects=true, body=<original>)`. No action, no reply to user.

Caveat: no pi docs reference `.thread/prompts/<role>.md` as a recognized prompt-loading path. If the thread harness doesn't pick these up, they need to be registered via settings or the coordinator's launch config. Format follows prompt-template convention with frontmatter block.
